name: motionframes
description: AI animation creator: animated videos from one spec file. Claude or Codex writes the story and scene art; MotionFrames times every scene, caption, mouth shape and sound effect to the voice and renders with HyperFrames.

interface.shortDescription: Animated videos timed to the voice, rendered locally
interface.longDescription: Write a topic, get an animated vertical video: story beats, characters that act and lip-sync, layered backdrops, camera moves, captions placed clear of faces, sound effects, -14 LUFS mix and a QA check. Free path: local Kokoro voice and local whisper timing.
defaultPrompt: Set up MotionFrames on this computer and make a test video
Make a 40-second animated short about why bridges have gaps
